The graph is a single connected cluster (a connected group of three or more nodes). There are 189 nodes and 2.8K links, where the average degree (links per node) is 30. Harvey Janus and Worf Peer have the highest degree centrality score of 226 (total number of links). The average clustering coefficient is 0. An average clustering coefficient of 1 indicates perfect local interconnectivity."
